key_findings: CCI upregulated spinal HDAC6 from day 3 to beyond day 21, expressed in dorsal horn neurons and microglia; microglial inhibition with minocycline reduced HDAC6.
HDAC6 inhibitor ACY-1215 reduced CCI-induced mechanical allodynia (not thermal hyperalgesia), neuronal c-Fos/p-CREB, NLRP3, NF-κB p65, caspase-1 p20, IL-18, TNF-α and IL-6 in spinal cord.
